data.one_liner: Detects how a Flutter app was installed on Android or iOS.
data.what_it_does: This plugin exposes the installation source (Google Play, App Store, TestFlight, etc.) and the package name or app ID. It provides both a Future API and widget helpers to consume the result.
use_when: You need to know the store or source for analytics or attribution.
You want to conditionally enable features based on the installation channel.
You need to log installation data for marketing campaigns.
avoid_when: Your app is only installed from a single known source and you don't need to track it.
You are targeting only one platform and prefer a simpler solution.
strengths: Modern Kotlin/Swift implementation with coroutine support.
Widget helpers for easy integration into UI.
Supports Swift Package Manager and updated Gradle/Kotlin DSL.
weaknesses: Requires Android minSdk 24 and Flutter 3.44 / Dart 3.12.
No support for other platforms (e.g., web, desktop).
Relies on native platform APIs, so debugging can be harder.
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec, import package, call InstallReferrer.referrer or use widget helpers. No build_runner or codegen needed.
